name: kk-agent-backend
description: Modular TypeScript API backend with a lightweight plugin system.

scripts.build: npm --prefix .. --workspace kk-agent-contract run build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: npm --prefix .. --workspace kk-agent-contract run build && tsx --test src/lib/error-middleware.test.ts src/plugins/agent/lib/mode-config.test.ts src/plugins/loop/lib/context-compaction.test.ts src/plugins/loop/lib/context-compaction-runner.test.ts src/plugins/provider/lib/endpoints/lmstudio-chat.test.ts src/plugins/provider/lib/errors.test.ts src/plugins/provider/lib/model-profiles/compiler.test.ts src/plugins/provider/lib/request-options.test.ts src/plugins/security/service.test.ts src/plugins/session/lib/runtime-context.test.ts src/plugins/session/lib/tool-call-description.test.ts src/plugins/skills/lib/xml.test.ts src/plugins/skills/routes.test.ts src/plugins/skills/service.test.ts src/plugins/systemprompt/lib/builder.test.ts src/plugins/tools/lib/filesystem/mutation.test.ts src/plugins/tools/lib/filesystem/ripgrep.test.ts src/plugins/tools/lib/system-config.test.ts src/plugins/tools/lib/terminal/shell-profile.test.ts src/plugins/tools/lib/terminal/command-policy.test.ts src/plugins/tools/lib/terminal/approval-policy.test.ts src/plugins/tools/lib/terminal/runtime.test.ts
